title: Agent Kit commands catalog
description: Output of `agent-kit commands --json`: the workspace's slash commands read from .cursor/commands/*.md frontmatter. Versioned by catalogVersion: an added optional field is a minor bump, a removed or retyped field is a major bump. A host runs a row only through its own allowlist; `headless` is a hint, never a grant, and `context`, `interactiveOnly` and `audience` (1.1.0) can only narrow what a host runs. ADR 2026-10-22_colony-commands-catalog-contract (amend 2026-11-16, run with context).

kitVersion.description: Version of the Agent Kit CLI that produced the catalog.

commands.description: One row per .cursor/commands/<name>.md with a description line, sorted by name.

name.description: Slash name without the leading /. Rows that fail the pattern are dropped.

description.description: Frontmatter description. Untrusted text: render with textContent, never innerHTML.

layer.description: kit: a command the kit ships (a registry command row, any layer); factory: kit-maintainer only, never installed in consumer repos; project: a file the workspace added itself.

headless.description: The kit can dispatch this slash headless (agent-kit run). A hint, not permission to run it.

context.description: Since 1.1.0. What a host may append to /name as the one context argument: a goal typed by the user, a plan file, the current branch, a PR number or a commit SHA. none: the command takes no argument. Missing (older catalogs): none.

interactiveOnly.description: Since 1.1.0. Run only as an interactive session the user drives (git-prod, kit-prod): never headless, from a driver or run-plan tick, or with a pre-answered gate. Missing (older catalogs): false, and hosts keep their own production list.

audience.description: Since 1.1.0. meta: the command exists to build or ship the kit itself; hosts hide it outside the factory workspace. Missing (older catalogs): user.
